newsitem.title: GERMANY: German passenger travel to E Europe, CIS up 5.4pct.
newsitem.headline: German passenger travel to E Europe, CIS up 5.4pct.

text.p: Demand for air travel from Germany to eastern Europe, Russia and CIS states rose 5.4 percent to 1.74 million passengers last year, the German airports association (ADV) said.
The top destination was Russia with 10.7 percent growth to 532,742 passengers, an ADV statement said.
The second-largest eastern European market, Poland, grew 14.9 percent to 291,269 passengers, it added.
Hungary increased 8.6 percent to 286,124 passengers but the Czech Republic fell eight percent to 179,549 travellers.
Markets showing strong growth rates were Ukraine with an 18 percent rise and Usbekistan with 18.3 percent growth.

The ADV said it expected further growth for eastern Europe and CIS states this year given a 5.5 percent increase to 852 weekly flights from Germany to 46 destinations this summer. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
